description: This PHP class 'Sanitizer' resides in the OrangeHRM project, specifically within the 'Utility' namespace of the 'orangehrmCorePlugin'. Its primary purpose is to sanitize SVG content using an external SVG sanitizer library, and it throws an exception if the sanitization fails.

classes.name: Sanitizer
classes.description: A utility class providing SVG sanitization functionality using an external sanitizer library.

methods.name: sanitizeSvg
methods.description: Sanitizes the provided SVG content string, returning the sanitized version or throwing an exception if invalid.
